metadata.description: Lore — workflow and knowledge layer for AI-coding teams.

plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: Workflow and knowledge layer for teams coding with Claude Code — small repo-scoped context at session start, facts filed where they have a reader (issues, PRs, ADRs, team wiki, logbook), the rest pulled on demand over MCP. Ships the build skills too: orient, grilling, to-epic, build, tdd, debug, document, experiment, handover, file-issue, triage.
